description:
Full parity port of pi-mono's compaction subsystem, the branch-summarization subsystem it shares utilities with, and the SessionManager tree model both depend on. Includes thinking-model summarization paths and TUI surfaces.

## Upstream sources (read implementation, not docs — per CLAUDE.md)

- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/compaction/compaction.ts (839 LOC)
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/compaction/branch-summarization.ts (355 LOC)
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/compaction/utils.ts (170 LOC)
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/compaction/index.ts
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts (entry types, tree, buildSessionContext, createCompactionSummaryMessage consumer)
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/messages.ts (createCompactionSummaryMessage builder + 'compactionSummary' role)
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts (SessionBeforeCompactEvent, SessionCompactEvent, SessionBeforeTreeEvent, SessionBeforeForkEvent)
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/settings-manager.ts (settings discovery + deepMergeSettings; project-precedence)
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/components/compaction-summary-message.ts (59 LOC)
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/components/tree-selector.ts (1,246 LOC)
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/interactive-mode.ts:4129 (Summarize? three-way prompt)

## Upstream tests to port (per 'port tests alongside' rule)

- test/compaction.test.ts
- test/compaction-serialization.test.ts
- test/compaction-summary-reasoning.test.ts
- test/compaction-thinking-model.test.ts
- test/compaction-extensions.test.ts
- test/compaction-extensions-example.test.ts
- test/agent-session-compaction.test.ts
- test/agent-session-auto-compaction-queue.test.ts
- test/agent-session-tree-navigation.test.ts
- test/agent-session-stats.test.ts
- test/session-manager/tree-traversal.test.ts
- test/session-manager/build-context.test.ts
- test/trigger-compact-extension.test.ts
- test/interactive-mode-compaction.test.ts
- Fixtures: test/fixtures/before-compaction.jsonl, test/fixtures/large-session.jsonl

## Existing scaffolding to build on (verified)

- OctoPi.Coder.SessionStore — write-only JSONL, v3 byte-compatible (apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/session_store.ex)
- Extension events all defined at apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/event.ex: :session_before_compact, :session_compact, :session_before_fork, :session_before_tree, :session_tree
- Stub extensions: TriggerCompact (100k threshold @ trigger_compact.ex:10), CustomCompaction (canned summary @ custom_compaction.ex:59-65)
- Extension API stubs in apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/api.ex: get_branch, get_leaf_entry_id, get_context_usage, compact (all stubbed; bodies missing). get_entries exists on Context but NOT on API.
- Context.find_model declared but stub-bound to nil_model/2 (context.ex:32, 45) — opi-rcg.4 shipped the field but not the binding.
- AI.Usage struct: input/output/cache_read/cache_write/total_tokens/cost (apps/octo_pi_ai/lib/octo_pi/ai/usage.ex:12-26)
- MessageLog is APPEND-ONLY (push/append_many/to_list/count) — no drop/replace. Per upstream pattern, compaction never mutates MessageLog; kept-window is computed at prompt-assembly via build_session_context.

## Verified upstream details

- shouldCompact(contextTokens, contextWindow, settings) → contextTokens > contextWindow - settings.reserveTokens (compaction.ts:219-222)
- Reasoning conditional: model.reasoning && thinkingLevel && thinkingLevel !== 'off' (compaction.ts:569-572)
- generateBranchSummary calls completeSimple directly (NOT generateSummary) — branch-summarization.ts:283-328
- createCompactionSummaryMessage returns role: 'compactionSummary' (NEW role; messages.ts:62-67, 109-120) — providers must handle serialization
- buildSessionContext inserts the synthetic message at start of kept list (session-manager.ts:390-392)
- 'Summarize?' prompt is THREE-WAY: ['Summarize', 'Summarize with custom prompt', 'No summary'] (interactive-mode.ts:4129)
- Settings: project (<cwd>/.pi/settings.json) overrides global (~/.pi/agent/settings.json) via deepMergeSettings (settings-manager.ts:146-153, 258, 105-133)

See child tickets for full breakdown. Tickets are dependency-ordered within phases; cross-phase deps wired via 'bw dep add'.
title: Compaction & branch summarization (full pi-mono parity)
